name: Solo Founder Ops Desk
tagline: Runs like a one-person company's COO, routing work to the specialist bots beneath it
description: Place it above the bots you run and it becomes the desk that hands work out: research to one, quality checks to another, coding, design and social posting elsewhere. Weekday routines keep customer conversations flowing in, so nothing waits on your memory. The optional trading sub-agent is paper-only, never funded.
author: dodgeking3171
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
